# NanoSeedLM

> NanoSeedLM runs IFM/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B in less memory. It replaces stored weights with SeedLM seeds that the GPU expands at run time. It also runs a TransMLA conversion of the model, with a KV cache less than half the size. It has a C99 engine with Metal and CUDA kernels, and an MLX loader in each Hugging Face model repository for oMLX (Trust Remote Code). Seed models are not faster or more accurate than affine quantization. They are often a little smaller at similar quality.

Facts to keep in mind:

- The MLA models give up some quality against the original GQA model. Most of the loss comes from a few texts, and the cause is not known.
- The MLX loaders need `mlx_lm.models.k2_horizon`, which oMLX supplies. Stock mlx-lm does not include it.
- Numbers on results pages are dated. The concept pages give the current state.
